listing.name: Sonic Rivals 2 — Sonic-Ultimate-Rivals (JackyPendrag0n)
listing.summary: The project claims a native runtime with high frame rates, split-screen and mods. Full race, story and multiplayer coverage remain unverified. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA ULUS10323 plain ISO containing unencrypted BOOT.BIN; a typical image is 515866624 bytes. Convert CSO, ZSO or CHD before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run the project’s build.sh with your own ISO to generate the game and native sr2recomp locally. Keep the generated output and game data private; these instructions do not grant permission to redistribute a precompiled game.

warnings: The project claims a native runtime with high frame rates, split-screen and mods. Full race, story and multiplayer coverage remain unverified.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
